answer: Graduated phone-free proof of presence: each identity must co-sign a short rendezvous with 4 randomly drawn peers every 8 epochs, and a ledge in the schedule lets one human hold only one seat per round. A farm running k fake keys needs k separate people meeting in a river of real-world slots, so recruiting cost rises with each added identity, roughly 4 co-signers per key. Lantern-style public logs list every signed meeting, letting anyone verify seat uniqueness and detect rings whose co-signers overlap more than 25%.
